access.door_assumption: Declared entrance assumed fully open without leaf geometry; no hinge or sweep acceptance.
limits: Full-height AABB footprints are conservative, including gaps within furniture.
Grid 0.02 m and square body scenarios; not a human model or accessibility standard.
A failed conservative route is a warning, not proof no human route exists.
A successful route does not verify sitting, opening storage, reaching, turning or comfort.

free_floor.scope: Empty axis-aligned floor rectangle under conservative AABBs and assumed clear height, anywhere in room; not an activity pass or reachable human area.

limits: Presence does not establish use; static doors/lids/folds/services not simulated.
Surface intersection is not penetration depth; absence does not rule out containment or instability.
Conservative AABB routes may block gaps; endpoints are deterministic hypotheses, not measured resident needs.
Sanitary enclosure, privacy, installation, comfort and aesthetics remain unknown.
One source-inspired research shell, no sealed-test, professional or generalization claim.
